scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:run && npm run build && npm run check:bundle && npm run test:e2e:smoke
scripts.native:sync: VITE_BASE_PATH=/ npm run build && cap sync
scripts.native:sync:android: VITE_BASE_PATH=/ npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.native:sync:ios: VITE_BASE_PATH=/ npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.native:build:android: VITE_BASE_PATH=/ npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.native:build:ios: VITE_BASE_PATH=/ npm run build && cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath ios/App/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.native:build:android:release: VITE_BASE_PATH=/ npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.native:build:android:release:apk: VITE_BASE_PATH=/ npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.native:archive:ios: : "${IOS_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM:?Set IOS_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM to your Apple Developer Team ID}" && VITE_BASE_PATH=/ npm run build && cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination "generic/platform=iOS" -archivePath ios/App/build/App.xcarchive DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$IOS_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM" MARKETING_VERSION="${IOS_MARKETING_VERSION:-$npm_package_version}" CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION="${IOS_BUILD_NUMBER:-1}" -allowProvisioningUpdates archive
scripts.native:build:ios:release: npm run native:archive:ios && npm run native:export:ios
